description.en: Prostrate axes repeatedly produce K-shaped branching units and descending root-bearing shoots.
description.zh: 伏地枝轴反复产生K形分枝单元和向下的生根枝。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Sengelia radicans; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Sengelia radicans 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: K-branch topology defines the model rather than increasing the density of another naked-axis plant.
distinctness.zh: 以K形分枝拓扑定义模型，而非增加另一裸轴植物的密度。

modeling_brief.en: Lay connected angular K-junctions close to the ground; use a few lifted shoots to show directional branching.
modeling_brief.zh: 把连续K形节点贴地排列，以少量抬高枝条显示分枝方向。

uncertainty: Mat extent and missing tips are not fixed; reconstruction follows the organismal study.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: An organismal concept for Sengelia radicans
sources.supports: Whole-plant evidence for prostrate axes, K-branching and root-bearing shoots.
